entities.name: Gunnar Sträng
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gunnar Georg Emanuel Sträng was a Swedish trade unionist and statesman who served as Minister for Finance for 21 years from 1955 to 1976. A prominent member of the Social Democratic Party, Sträng represented Västra Götaland in the Riksdag from 1946 to 1985.

entities.name: Gunnar Sträng
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gunnar Georg Emanuel Sträng was a Swedish trade unionist and statesman who served as Minister for Finance for 21 years from 1955 to 1976. A prominent member of the Social Democratic Party, Sträng represented Västra Götaland in the Riksdag from 1946 to 1985.
